newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Koa Denko says can't explain stock surge.
newsitem.headline: Koa Denko says can't explain stock surge.

text.p: Electrical products maker Koa Denko (Malaysia) Bhd said on Thursday it cannot explain why its stock rose sharply in recent days.
In a reply to a Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange query on the stock's movement, the company said in a statement it was not aware of any rumours which have boosted the shares.
"The unusual market action is beyond their understanding and knowledge," said Koa Denko, the Malaysian unit of Japan's Koa Corp.
The stock was suspended about 20 minutes into Thursday's opening, being last traded at 11.50 ringgit, down 30 cents.
At 11.50, the shares have jumped 42.8 percent from 8.05 ringgit seven days ago on January 2.
